description: Search the web: ranked results with title, url, snippet and a longer summary. Pass need_content=true for the page text. Charges a flat RUB price per request that returns results; an empty result is free.

count.description: How many results to return (the price does not change).
count.title: Count

localization.description: IPv4/IPv6 address to localise the results for (optional).
localization.title: Localization

need_content.description: true fills `content` with the page text; false leaves it empty (snippet and summary are always set).
need_content.title: Need Content

ori_question.description: The user's original question, if the query was rewritten from it: helps ranking.
ori_question.title: Ori Question

query.description: What to search for, 1-128 characters. Operators: site:, -site:, -word, "exact phrase", lang:ru,en, after:2025-01-01, before:2026-01-01.
query.title: Query

name: web_search
